desc:
The animals are FROZEN in ice and drifting down the rushing river! Help rescue them! 🧊🐾

1. Break the ice blocks floating down the river! ⛏️🌊
2. Rescue trapped animals before they drift away! 🧊
3. Bring them safely back to your warm ranch! 🏡
4. Your pets collect cash so you can UPGRADE TO BETTER PICKAXES! 💵⚡

Will you RESCUE all the animals? 🔓
💸 YOUR PETS GENERATE CASH TO HELP YOU UPGRADE! 💸

LIKE the game and join the GROUP for special rewards! 👍
